text: Based on the evidence provided, the tool cannot determine whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal. While it confirms that tree-cover loss of about 81.3 ha occurred within the asset, it does not establish the cause of the change, nor does it provide information on the legality or authorization of the activity. The evidence also does not identify who carried out or is responsible for the change, or any regulatory or compliance findings. Therefore, the question of whether the tree-cover loss was illegal remains unanswered.
